correctness.rationale: Direct matrix-unit calculation gives partial transpose exchange of flip and maximally entangled tensor. Their joint eigenvalues yield two weighted coordinates exactly, and equality in Holder duality gives the full restricted operator norm and uniqueness of its maximizers. The endpoint full two-level norm is bounded by elementary row-column Cauchy-Schwarz for partial transpose and attained by the embedded 2x2 witness. p=2 orthogonal projection and strict p!=2 cases follow with no limits or numerics.

value.rationale: The plane is the minimal partial-transpose-invariant span containing the flip, not an arbitrary slice; its norm is the natural exact quantitative obstruction compatible with the p=4 two-level qualitative example. All-p,n exact constants and equality vectors yield an explicit dimension-independent gap at amplification level two, plus exact endpoint full norms. The constrained exact invariant is useful as a benchmark for noncommutative operator-space projection theory; no theorem about unknown finite-p full norm is asserted.
